g.title: PayTrace_Architecture
g.text: Modular 3-Tier Enterprise Architecture • RBAC Security • Procedural Business Logic • ACID Transactions

g.title: client_tier
g.text: Vanilla HTML5 / Responsive CSS3 (Custom Properties) / ES6 Modules • Port: 3000
4 Headcount & Liability KPIs, Quick Action Triggers
Roster CRUD & Salary Structure Assignment Modal
Departmental calendar filter & tardy check-in review
Request queue, approve/reject workflow & admin remarks
Immutable historical mutation inspection with JSON diffs
Active compensation summary & quick shift status
Daily check-in/out with automated late arrival evaluation
Leave requests with client-side boundary validation
Frozen master snapshot & normalized line-item modal
CSS print stylesheets for clean salary slip vouchers
Hardened boundaries preventing peer record access

g.title: backend_tier
g.text: APPLICATION & SECURITY LAYER • Node.js v26+ / Express.js 5+
REST API Server (src/server.js, src/app.js) • Stateless JWT Authentication • Role-Based Access Control
Verifies Bearer JWT signature via JWT_SECRET; validates active DB employee status
Anti-tampering / IDOR defense: ensures regular staff access strictly their own data
Connection pool, keepAlive: true, multipleStatements: true for CALL sp_*

g.title: client_tier->backend_tier
g.text: HTTP/1.1 REST Requests (JSON) • Bearer JWT / Cookie

g.title: database_tier
g.text: DATA & BUSINESS LOGIC LAYER • MariaDB 13.0+ (InnoDB Storage Engine)
Strict ACID Guarantees • Procedural Business Logic • Composite Indexes • Declarative Triggers
Atomic transaction, pro-rata gross, tax, unpaid leave, late penalties, inserts master & items. Handled by EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION with ROLLBACK.
Cursor-driven batch processing across active staff with processed/error counters.
Simulates constraint violation, verifies safe ROLLBACK with zero orphaned rows.
Check-out > check-in validation; leave conflict rejection; late flag & minutes calculation (>09:15).
Boundary checking (start ≤ end); overlap rejection for approved records.
JSON diff snapshot inserted to audit_logs.

g.title: backend_tier->database_tier
g.text: SQL DML, Transaction Control & CALL sp_*()
